packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator responsible for a flight, submitting the ATC flight plan and providing TOBT and related estimates.

operations.name: provideFlightPlanData
operations.description: The AO must provide correct information before the first E-DPI message, in order to feed Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration, and first destination data, as early in time as possible.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party performing turn-round and ground handling operations on behalf of, or alongside, the Aircraft Operator.

classes.name: AirTrafficControlUnit
classes.definition: Any ATC unit (Area Control Centre, Approach Control, Tower, or ATS unit) that receives the flight plan, detects the flight, or issues approvals.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, receives DPI messages, and monitors flight progress via ETFMS/FUM.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: The CTOT is issued by the Network Operations and sent to relevant ATS units as well as the departure aerodrome; if the flight is regulated, a CTOT is issued at EOBT-2h.

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the submitted ATC flight plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS; all involved ATC units receive the flight plan, including departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and aircrew who request start-up, coordinate boarding and turn-round management, and receive TSAT confirmation.

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The stakeholder responsible for stand and gate allocation, sharing EOBT and reacting to stand/gate change decisions.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single scheduled arrival or departure operation of an aircraft, carrying an operational status that changes at each milestone.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The flight's current operational status, changed at each milestone from INITIATED through DEPARTED/TAKE OFF.

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; appropriate fields are marked as REGULATED at EOBT-2hr (milestone 2), and regulated status affects whether a T-DPI-s is sent (milestone 10) and whether ATC must assure the flight respects its CTOT (milestone 13).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round linking an arriving flight and its related departing flight, including the defined turn-round period.

attributes.name: turnRoundPeriod
attributes.description: The defined or estimated turn-round period for the departing flight, used to calculate TOBT after ALDT, AIBT, or ACGT (milestones 6, 7, 8).

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by type and registration, which may be updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration, provided by the AO before the first E-DPI message to feed Network Operations with consistent data.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, which the ATC Flight Plan may be used to update.

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO ATC flight plan submitted for a flight, possibly as part of a repetitive flight plan (RFPL), describing departure and destination aerodromes.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the flight plan is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) submitted to cover daily or weekly flights.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: The Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL, used with ATOT to calculate ELDT when the departure airport is more than 3 hours flying time from the destination (milestone 3).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated to a flight at a coordinated airport, against which the ATC flight plan and airport flight data are checked for consistency.

classes.name: Aerodrome
classes.definition: An airport, whether the departure, destination, or outstation aerodrome, involved in a flight's origin or destination.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the off-block event (SOBT, EOBT, TOBT, or AOBT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update; every successive value is kept.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this off-block time is the scheduled (SOBT), estimated (EOBT), target (TOBT), or actual (AOBT) value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time of the off-block event for this prefix.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided this value, such as the AO/GH, ATC, or an automated docking/ACARS system.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded, so successive values can be kept and analysed afterwards.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; AOBT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 15).

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the landing event (ELDT or ALDT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this landing time is estimated (ELDT) or actual (ALDT).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time of the landing event for this prefix.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided this value, such as ATC, ACARS, or Network Operations FUM.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded, appended rather than overwriting the prior value.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ALDT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 6).

operations.name: updateFromFum
operations.description: For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by the FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight.

operations.name: calculateFromAtot
operations.description: If the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from the destination airport, an ELDT can be calculated by using the ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the in-block event (EIBT or AIBT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this in-block time is estimated (EIBT) or actual (AIBT).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time of the in-block event for this prefix.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided this value, such as ACARS, an automated docking system, ATC systems, or manual input.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded, appended rather than overwriting the prior value.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; AIBT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 7).

operations.name: calculateFromEldt
operations.description: An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time.

operations.name: calculateFromAldt
operations.description: The EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT + EXIT.

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the take-off event (ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, or ATOT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this take-off time is estimated (ETOT), target (TTOT), calculated (CTOT), or actual (ATOT).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time of the take-off event for this prefix.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided this value, such as ATC, ACARS, or Network Operations.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded, appended rather than overwriting the prior value.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ATOT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestones 3, 16).

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT; a tolerance of 5 minutes is used after take-off from outstation (milestone 3).

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the start-up approval event (TSAT or ASAT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this value is the target (TSAT) or actual (ASAT) start-up approval time.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time of the start-up approval event for this prefix.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party that provided this value, namely ATC.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded, appended rather than overwriting the prior value.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ASAT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 14).

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window within which start-up must be requested and approved (milestones 9-14).

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which start-up is requested (ASRT), recorded with its origin and time of update.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time at which start-up is requested (ASRT).

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party that provided this value, namely ATC based on the pilot's request.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ASRT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 13).

attributes.name: toleranceWindow
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window inside which the start-up request must occur, after which AO/GH are alerted (milestone 13).

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back (ARDT), recorded with its origin and time of update.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time at which the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back (ARDT).

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party that provided this value, namely the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ARDT is directly available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 12).

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance after TOBT at which AO/GH are informed that no ARDT or ready status has been received (milestone 12).

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The actual start boarding time (ASBT) at which the gate opens for passengers to board.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time at which boarding starts (ASBT).

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party or system that provided this value, namely the automatic airport system or manual input by AO/GH.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ASBT is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 11).

classes.name: GroundHandlingTime
classes.definition: The actual commence of ground handling time (ACGT), applicable to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time at which ground handling operations commence (ACGT).

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The party that provided this value, namely the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time at which this value was recorded.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the value; ACGT data is available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 8).

classes.name: TaxiTime
classes.definition: An estimated taxi duration, either taxi-out (EXOT) or taxi-in (EXIT), used in the calculation of other time quantities.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Whether this is the estimated taxi-out time (EXOT) or estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The estimated duration of the taxi phase, used in the calculation of TTOT or EIBT.

attributes.name: calculationBasis
attributes.description: For EXOT, the basis of calculation: predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the holding position (milestone 9).

classes.name: MinimumTurnRoundTime
classes.definition: The minimum turn-round time (MTTT) defined for an aircraft type, used as a calculation basis for TTOT.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The minimum turn-round time (MTTT) defined for an aircraft type, used as a calculation basis for TTOT (milestones 2, 3).

classes.name: FlightPlanActivationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 1: checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, airport slot, and airport flight data, and confirms the flight to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: triggerOffset
attributes.description: The nominal timing of this milestone, normally 3 hours before EOBT, though it may occur later (milestone 1).

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data; shall be performed to verify this consistency before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to the Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: triggerOnActivationOrResubmission
operations.description: Process is triggered by the first activation of the ATC Flight Plan (earliest EOBT-3 hr), or new or late submissions of the ATC Flight Plan, after cancellation or revised EOBT.

operations.name: updateArrivalOrDepartureTimings
operations.description: ELDT and EIBT updated for an arrival; EOBT and ETOT updated for a departure.

classes.name: TtotCalculationMilestone
classes.definition: The common TTOT calculation rule shared by the EOBT-2hr check and the take-off-from-outstation check: TTOT is based on EIBT+MTTT+EXOT (or EOBT+EXOT if later), overridden by TOBT+EXOT once TOBT is available.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT takes into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, compared against EOBT+EXOT (the later of the two applies); in the case of manual input of TOBT, or once TOBT is available, this prediction overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (milestones 2 and 3).

classes.name: RegulationCheckMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 2 (EOBT-2hr): checks AO/GH flight estimates against the ATC Flight Plan, determines CTOT for regulated flights, and informs Network Operations via a T-DPI message.

attributes.name: triggerOffset
attributes.description: The fixed timing of this milestone, occurring at EOBT-2 hours (milestone 2).

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks (before or after take off from outstation) whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimated off block time at EOBT-2 hrs.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsViaTDpi
operations.description: At EOBT-2 hrs Network Operations is informed through the first T-DPI message about the updated take off time estimate.

operations.name: markFieldsAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for a flight that has received a CTOT, setting the flight's regulated attribute.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 3: checks estimated landing times after take-off from the outstation against the outbound ATC Flight Plan and informs Network Operations via a T-DPI-t message.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan; shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan at take off from outstation.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsViaTDpiT
operations.description: When needed, informs the Network Operations about the updated take off time estimates using a T-DPI-t Message; a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TobtCheckMilestone
classes.definition: The common TOBT-feasibility check and TTOT-tolerance notification performed at each milestone from Local Radar Update through Final Confirmation of the TOBT: verify that TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan and inform Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed tolerance.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT (milestones 4-9).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsOfTtotChange
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (milestones 4-9).

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdateMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 4: commences the TOBT process on radar detection of the flight in the FIR, checking TOBT feasibility and TTOT tolerance, and constrains stand/gate changes near ELDT.

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process; triggered by the detection of the flight by radar in either FIR, TMA, or on Final Approach.

operations.name: checkStandGateChangeAllowed
operations.description: Taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT), any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30'.

classes.name: FinalApproachMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 5: commences the TOBT process on radar detection of the flight on final approach.

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process; triggered by the detection of the flight by radar in either FIR, TMA, or on Final Approach.

classes.name: LandedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 6: on ALDT, updates downstream time estimates for the departing flight based on the turn-round period.

operations.name: triggerDownstreamUpdatesFromAldt
operations.description: The occurrence of ALDT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: InBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 7: on AIBT, updates downstream time estimates for the departing flight based on the turn-round period.

operations.name: triggerDownstreamUpdatesFromAibt
operations.description: The occurrence of AIBT should trigger an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStartedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 8: on ACGT, for first-of-day or long-parked flights, updates the TOBT for the departing flight based on the turn-round period.

operations.name: triggerTobtUpdateFromAcgt
operations.description: The occurrence of ACGT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT is updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: FinalTobtConfirmationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 9: checks that the AO/GH's most accurate TOBT, provided t minutes before EOBT, is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan prior to TSAT issue.

attributes.name: localParameterT
attributes.description: The locally agreed parameter t, the number of minutes before EOBT at which the AO/GH must provide the final confirmed TOBT (milestone 9).

operations.name: confirmTobt
operations.description: Triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before.

classes.name: TsatIssuedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 10: informs partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight and checks whether TOBT updates after TSAT issue exceed a locally defined tolerance.

attributes.name: localParameterT
attributes.description: The locally agreed parameter t, the number of minutes before EOBT/TOBT at which TSAT is issued (milestone 10).

operations.name: informPartnersOfTsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsViaTDpiS
operations.description: The Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCountAfterTsat
operations.description: A check shall be performed to see the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued. In case the number of TOBT updates exceeds a threshold, then the TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStartsMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 11: informs partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time and checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT.

attributes.name: triggerOffset
attributes.description: The locally defined time variable, in minutes before TOBT, at which the boarding status check is triggered (milestone 11).

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsbt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain time before TOBT (local variable e.g. corresponding to aircraft type) a check shall be performed to check the boarding status, and inform the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated.

classes.name: AircraftReadyMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 12: informs partners of the Actual Ready Time and alerts AO/GH if TOBT has passed without an ARDT or ready status message.

operations.name: informPartnersOfArdt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start up / push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and there has not been a ready status message yet.

classes.name: StartUpRequestedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 13: informs partners of the Actual Start-Up Request Time and alerts partners if no start-up request is made within the TSAT tolerance window.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsrt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT) in the Airport CDM Platform.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestedWithinTolerance
operations.description: If the start up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, the AO/GH is informed that no start up has been requested, and should update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApprovedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 14: informs partners of the Actual Start-Up Approval Time and checks and alerts if approval is not aligned with or granted by TSAT tolerance.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual start up approval Time (ASAT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start up approval / push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance to TSAT and alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been granted; in case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners should be informed.

operations.name: resequenceFlight
operations.description: The flight will be re-sequenced when start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance.

classes.name: OffBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 15: informs partners of the Actual Off-Block Time, updates TTOT considering EXOT, and triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAobt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back / taxi from parking position.

operations.name: updateTtotConsideringExot
operations.description: TTOT updated considering the EXOT.

operations.name: sendADpi
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations or, in the case of remote holding, at a defined time prior to TTOT.

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndSendADpi
operations.description: After a first A-DPI is sent this check shall be performed to check TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 16: informs partners of the actual take-off, generates an airborne message, sends FSA and MVT messages, and removes the flight from the departure sequence.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTakeOff
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessageAndRemoveFromSequence
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

operations.name: sendFsaAndMvt
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated per flight, processes all available flight information, computes updated times, and triggers the DPI process and partner notifications.

operations.name: calculateTobtAutomatically
operations.description: Update of the ELDT can trigger a new TOBT to be entered by the AO/GH, or calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform.

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for this flight, and all available information is processed.

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC system that provides radar/system-derived times (ALDT, TSAT context) and calculates EXOT based on traffic load, gate/stand location, runway, and holding position.

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: Following the receipt of the TOBT, the ATC system will calculate and provide the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position.

classes.name: RadarSystem
classes.definition: The radar system that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code when it crosses a FIR/ATC boundary, a defined range/position, or a predetermined level.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: The radar system is able to detect a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when the flight crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary (milestone 4), or crosses either a defined range/position or passes/leaves a predetermined level (milestone 5).

classes.name: EtfmsSystem
classes.definition: The Network Operations system (ETFMS) that monitors a flight's progress within 3 hours flying time of the destination and issues Flight Update Messages.

operations.name: monitorProgressAndSendFum
operations.description: If the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport the Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: AcarsSystem
classes.definition: The ACARS system fitted to equipped aircraft that reports actual times such as landing, in-block, off-block, and take-off.

classes.name: AutomatedDockingSystem
classes.definition: An automated docking or ground surveillance system (e.g. A-SMGCS) that detects in-block, off-block, or take-off events.

classes.name: PassengerInformationSystem
classes.definition: The airport system, flight information display system (FIDS), or public address system used to inform passengers of boarding.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI) sent to Network Operations to convey updated flight time estimates.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Which kind of DPI message this is: E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI.

operations.name: canBeSent
operations.description: The E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM sent by Network Operations providing updates of a flight's progress used to update ELDT.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The RDY message confirming that the aircraft is ready and follows the indicated TOBT.

classes.name: DepartureClearanceMessage
classes.definition: The DCL message or voice communication by which flight crew requests start-up.

classes.name: TakeOffNotificationMessage
classes.definition: A notification message sent at take-off (FSA, MVT, or airborne message) informing partners and Network Operations of the actual take-off.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Which kind of take-off notification this is: FSA, MVT, or airborne message.

unmodelled: Milestone 1 refers to Attachment 2 for details of the DPI process implementation, which the document does not further specify.

The distinction between coordinated and non-coordinated airports (milestone 1), affecting whether the outbound flight is already known or must be initiated from the flight plan, is a rule about airport type rather than a standalone class.

The generic term 'Airport CDM Partners' used throughout milestones 9-16 to denote all stakeholders collectively is not modelled as its own class since it is a collective reference to the existing stakeholder classes.

Milestone 8 notes that Ground Handling Started is specific to flights that are the first operation of the day or have been long-term parked, a qualifying condition on when the milestone applies rather than a separate class.
Milestone 12 mentions roles such as Dispatcher/Supervisor/Redcap coordinating with the Ground Handler, which are not separately modelled beyond the GroundHandler stakeholder.
Section 3.7.3 referenced in milestone 1 for DPI process details is not included in the document and cannot be modelled further.

Milestone 8's Action on CDM Operation mentions 'ETTT' alongside TOBT and TTOT updates, but the document does not define this quantity distinctly from the existing time classes, so it cannot be modelled as a separate typed attribute.
